source_caption_text:
Thug was in his bag 😭🔥

Life when Young Thug dropped “Best Friend” just felt different. That song was everywhere, and Thug was on such a crazy run in 2015 that it felt like he couldn’t miss.

2015 Young Thug really had me in a chokehold 😭. The weird flows, high-pitched vocals, wild ad-libs and completely unpredictable energy made everything he dropped feel different from everybody else.

“Best Friend” is one of those songs that instantly takes you back to that era. You had to be there when Thugger was running around with that sound and everybody was trying to figure out what he was doing.

#youngthug #hiphop #rap
